settings.editor: Left alone, rot can spread into framing and cause major structural damage. We find it, repair it and stop it coming back.

background_image.alt: Stained deck on a log home

settings.editor:
Wood rot is caused by decay fungi, which need oxygen, heat, food and moisture. We can't change the first two, so we take away the other two. Borate preservatives treat the wood so the fungi can't feed on it.

Borates wash out over time, so we keep the wood dry as well: copper caps on exposed log ends and post tops, and flashing on beams. When wood is too far gone, we replace it. Our parent company builds log homes, so structural log and beam replacement is part of what we do.

• Inspection for hidden rot
  • Borate preservative treatment
  • Copper caps on log ends and post tops, flashing on beams
  • Replacement of rotted logs, beams and deck framing
Rot often hides under a sound-looking surface. We probe and inspect the areas most at risk.
Damaged wood is cut out and replaced, from a single log end to a structural beam.
Borate preservatives protect the surrounding wood from decay.
Copper caps, flashing and a good finish keep water out, so the borates stay put.
